referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the processes included in the production of 1.06m2 (corresponding to 1m2 visible area) double glazing (2-IV, LSG) with a U-value below 1.1 W/m2K. It can be applied for laminated safety double glazing used in the building sector. 1 m2 visible glazing area has a final weight of 26 kg.; UUID: b510d811-7fb0-319d-b74f-954526aa999f
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included in this dataset are the materials and production processes of 1.06m2 (corresponding to 1m2 visible area) LSG double glazing (2-IV, LSG) with a U-value below 1.1 W/m2K including disposal of waste water and production wastes.
